themes.description: The dissemination of entertainment, information, and news via television, radio, and online channels, reaching a broad audience through structured programming and on-demand services.

linked_companies.description: Operates a comprehensive network of television stations and digital media properties, focusing on the production and distribution of broadcast content to diverse audiences.
linked_companies.evidence: Nexstar operates as a quintessential media broadcasting company, structurally defined by its vast network of 265 full-power local television stations and national networks such as The CW and NewsNation. This broadcasting infrastructure generates nearly all of the company's financial top-line, exemplified by recent first-quarter results where distribution and advertising revenues accounted for roughly 99% of its $1.4 billion in consolidated net revenue. Nexstar further cemented its scale as the largest local broadcaster in the United States through its landmark, multi-billion dollar acquisition of TEGNA, a strategic expansion driven by a commitment to local journalism and heavily protected by FCC regulatory moats.
linked_companies.name: NEXSTAR MEDIA GROUP INC

linked_companies.description: Owns and operates a vast portfolio of local television stations across the United States, delivering network programming, local news, and syndicated content to diverse regional audiences.
linked_companies.evidence: Sinclair’s enterprise is foundationally driven by media broadcasting, with its dedicated Local Media segment operating extensive over-the-air television networks that recently generated $701 million, accounting for nearly 87% of quarterly company revenue. The company leverages this local and national reach to distribute programming such as live sports and local journalism, enabling it to capture 78% of the broadcast commercial inventory for political advertising among key adult demographics. To reinforce its core broadcasting operations, Sinclair consistently executes strategic M&A, including recent accretive duopoly acquisitions in Providence and Tulsa, while directing capital expenditures toward next-generation ATSC 3.0 data casting infrastructure via EdgeBeam.
linked_companies.name: SINCLAIR INC

linked_companies.description: Operates major television networks and local stations, delivering a comprehensive slate of news, live sports, and entertainment programming to diverse audiences worldwide.
linked_companies.evidence: The company's media broadcasting operations are driven by its TV Media segment, anchored by the CBS network which recently captured 13 of the top 20 primetime series. This linear broadcasting footprint serves as a primary content distribution arm, driving viewership through primetime entertainment and major live events like the NFL and the Masters. Accounting for nearly half of total corporate revenue, the division maximizes its reach via 28 owned-and-operated stations, domestic cable channels, and international free-to-air networks. To navigate secular declines in linear television, management is actively rightsizing programming to maintain stable profitability while expanding its broadcasting asset portfolio through strategic transactions involving Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery.
linked_companies.name: PARAMOUNT SKYDANCE CL B

linked_companies.description: Delivers satellite and digital audio broadcasting services, offering a comprehensive range of exclusive music, sports, talk, and news programming to a widespread subscriber base.
linked_companies.evidence: SiriusXM operates as a market leader in satellite radio broadcasting and digital audio aggregation, reaching 255 million monthly listeners or nearly 90 percent of the United States population. The company disseminates exclusive artist-led channels, national news programs like the Megyn Kelly Channel, and live sports across its proprietary satellite networks and online platforms. This fundamental broadcast segment dominates the corporate financial structure, generating $1.6 billion of the company's $2.09 billion in total quarterly revenue. Supported by dedicated C-level leadership and continuous technology investments, SiriusXM leverages a fleet of 180 million enabled vehicles and its Pandora platforms to actively capture market share from traditional AM/FM networks.
linked_companies.name: SIRIUS XM HOLDINGS INC

linked_companies.description: Operates a comprehensive portfolio of broadcast and cable television networks, delivering live sports, news, and entertainment programming to global audiences through flagship channels and extensive content distribution.
linked_companies.evidence: Disney's engagement with media broadcasting is anchored by its extensive linear television networks, specifically ABC and ESPN, with the latter recognized by management as the biggest sports media brand in the world. Although navigating a transition where linear revenues are declining relative to streaming, the company centralizes its television operations within Disney Entertainment and leverages its cable networks as distinct studio brands to distribute crossover productions like The Bear and Shogun. This broadcasting reach is bolstered by the integration of the NFL Network and RedZone linear rights, complementing a live sports distribution strategy that recently drove multi-decade high viewership records for ABC college football and Monday Night Football. To support this programming distribution, Disney manages dedicated, FCC-regulated television stations and continues to fund essential infrastructure, recently directing a portion of a $601 million Entertainment segment capital expenditure toward upgrading its physical broadcast centers.
linked_companies.name: WALT DISNEY CO/THE

themes.name: Media Broadcasting

themes.description: Organizations operating various broadcasting and digital platforms, providing diverse programming spanning news, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle content to mass audiences.

linked_companies.description: Operates a comprehensive portfolio of domestic and international television networks, encompassing premium pay-TV, basic cable, and broadcast channels that distribute entertainment, news, and sports programming globally.
linked_companies.evidence: Warner Bros. Discovery’s alignment with the Media Networks theme is driven by its "Global Linear Networks" division, which operates as one of the company's three primary strategic pillars and is supported by a dedicated workforce of over 30,000 employees. This segment manages a comprehensive portfolio of broadcasting channels across news, sports, and entertainment—including CNN, TNT Sports, TBS, and TLC—that consistently deliver documented audience growth and record-breaking event viewership. The foundational importance of linear broadcasting is further evidenced by its massive operational scale, capturing 30% of all prime-time U.S. cable viewing and reaching over one billion people globally while generating nearly half of the company's total consolidated revenues. To sustain this extensive footprint, the company continues to allocate significant capital toward the segment, highlighted by billions of dollars invested in premium television network content and the acquisition of tier-one broadcast rights.
linked_companies.name: WARNER BROS DISCOVERY INC

linked_companies.description: Operates a vast portfolio of local television stations, national broadcast networks, and digital media platforms, delivering comprehensive news, sports, and entertainment programming to audiences nationwide.
linked_companies.evidence: Nexstar operates a comprehensive portfolio of local and national media networks that serves as its foundational corporate structure, generating $1.4 billion in quarterly net revenue. The company maintains distinct, branded network divisions like The CW for entertainment and sports programming, alongside NewsNation, which recently recorded an 85% viewer increase to become the fastest-growing primetime network across all major broadcast and cable channels. To support and scale these platforms, Nexstar executes substantial capital allocations directly into network operations, highlighted by $72 million in recent quarterly broadcast rights amortization and the $3.34 billion strategic acquisition of TEGNA to further expand its national distribution footprint.
linked_companies.name: NEXSTAR MEDIA GROUP INC

linked_companies.description: Functions as a global media network by producing and distributing authoritative news, multimedia journalism, and lifestyle content across digital, print, and audio platforms to a broad subscriber base.
linked_companies.evidence: The New York Times operates entirely as a multifaceted global media network, deriving 100 percent of its revenue from an expansive portfolio of interconnected digital broadcasting and publishing platforms. Under executive leadership, the company integrates diverse programming that spans independent news, lifestyle applications like Cooking and Wirecutter, audio networks such as Serial, and dedicated sports journalism through The Athletic to serve over 13 million subscribers. To further unify this multi-format ecosystem and reach tens of millions of users weekly, the organization is investing in centralized infrastructure, including a new app-based "watch tab" designed to curate diverse video content across politics, culture, and AI.
linked_companies.name: NEW YORK TIMES CO-A

linked_companies.description: Operates a comprehensive portfolio of broadcast and cable television networks, distributing entertainment, news, and sports programming to audiences globally.
linked_companies.evidence: Paramount's integration of Media Networks centers on operating a unified portfolio that synchronizes traditional television broadcasting with scaled direct-to-consumer platforms. The company anchors its distribution pipeline through the CBS broadcast network, which utilizes 28 owned stations and secures eight of the top ten television shows to drive mass audience reach. Complementing this traditional broadcasting framework, the company's TV Media segment oversees cable channels such as MTV, Nickelodeon, and BET, collectively generating the majority of Paramount's total pro forma revenue. Rather than spinning off these legacy assets, management is actively digitally transforming these linear networks to fuel its global streaming strategy across platforms like Paramount+ and Pluto TV, which currently support 79 million subscribers.
linked_companies.name: PARAMOUNT SKYDANCE CL B

linked_companies.description: Operates subscription television and media networks that deliver sports, entertainment, and news programming across broadcast and digital platforms.
linked_companies.evidence: News Corp's alignment with the Media Networks theme is driven by its dedicated News Media segment, which generated $538 million in the most recent quarter, accounting for 24.4% of the company's total revenue. The organization operates integrated global broadcasting and digital platforms—including News Corp Australia, News U.K., and talkSPORT—that collectively manage millions of recurring digital subscriptions to deliver news and sports content to mass audiences. Strategic focus on this theme is further evidenced by disciplined capital investments and dedicated workforce structuring to expand these networks, highlighted by the recent rollout of the California Post under the New York Post Media Group. Together with overarching platforms like the Wall Street Journal and Sky News Australia, these distinct multi-channel brands form the operational architecture of the company's media delivery ecosystem.
linked_companies.name: NEWS CORP - CLASS A

themes.name: Media Networks

themes.description: Entertainment sector focusing on sporting events, including professional leagues, spectator experiences, and athlete endorsements.

linked_companies.description: Operates premier mixed martial arts and professional wrestling franchises, driving the industry through the production of global live events, media broadcasting, and branded consumer products.
linked_companies.evidence: TKO operates entirely as a pure-play sports entertainment entity, generating all of its $1.597 billion in Q1 2026 revenue from wholly owned properties including UFC, WWE, IMG, and Professional Bull Riders (PBR). The company's organizational structure and executive leadership are dedicated to staging live arena events—such as WrestleMania 42, which drew over 106,000 fans—and monetizing these properties through over $15 billion in secured long-term media rights agreements. To expand audience reach and develop athletic rosters, TKO is executing direct capital deployments across its portfolio, including an eight-figure allocation for UFC fighter bonuses and a $30 million strategic investment for a promotional UFC event at the White House.
linked_companies.name: TKO GROUP HOLDINGS INC

linked_companies.description: Manages the commercial rights to the Formula One World Championship, driving global engagement in motorsport through international race promotion, media broadcasting agreements, and extensive sponsorship partnerships.
linked_companies.evidence: Liberty Media operates exclusively as a global sports investment vehicle focused entirely on managing and monetizing two professional motorsports properties: Formula 1 and MotoGP. The company's organizational structure and capital strategy reflect this dedication through distinct operating divisions led by dedicated C-level executives, backed by extensive financial commitments including the recent acquisition of MotoGP and direct infrastructure investments for the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Holding exclusive commercial rights and stabilized by long-term frameworks like the Concorde Agreement, the company derives its consolidated revenue completely from sports entertainment activities, driven by race promotions, global media broadcasts, and record-setting live spectator attendances.
linked_companies.name: LIBERTY MEDIA CORP-FORMULA-C

linked_companies.description: Drives the sports entertainment industry through the ownership and operation of major professional sports franchises that deliver live athletic events and immersive fan experiences.
linked_companies.evidence: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. operates exclusively within the sports entertainment sector, generating all of its revenue—including $403.4 million in Q1 2026—directly from event-related sales, broadcasting, hospitality, and sponsorships. The company's financial outcomes depend entirely on the on-court and on-ice competitiveness of the New York Knicks and Rangers, staging live home games at The Garden alongside high-profile properties like the NBA Cup and the NHL's Winter Classic. To further enhance these spectator experiences, MSG Sports recently allocated a $37.58 million increase in team personnel compensation to optimize rosters, while launching exclusive merchandise and curated theme nights such as the Rangers Centennial season. Furthermore, the organization aligns its entire C-suite leadership, marketing partnerships division, and facility investments—including training centers and arena operating leases—toward presenting these professional sporting events.
linked_companies.name: MADISON SQUARE GARDEN SPORTS

linked_companies.description: Operates premier horse racing venues, including the home of the Kentucky Derby, alongside regional casino gaming properties and online pari-mutuel wagering platforms that deliver comprehensive live sports and entertainment experiences.
linked_companies.evidence: Churchill Downs' foundation in sports entertainment is driven by its ownership and operation of elite live thoroughbred racing events, primarily the Kentucky Derby. The company recently expanded its footprint by securing a definitive agreement to acquire the intellectual property rights to the Preakness Stakes and Black-Eyed Susan Stakes, consolidating its control over the top two wagered-on races in the United States. Supported by a dedicated workforce of 300 track experts, the 'Live and Historical Racing' segment handles the operational demands of hosting hundreds of thousands of guests. To further compound premium live entertainment revenue, the company is executing multi-million dollar capital investments, such as the Victory Run development and suite renovations, to expand seating capacity and elevate spectator experiences.
linked_companies.name: CHURCHILL DOWNS INC

linked_companies.description: Drives interactive fan engagement through a comprehensive digital platform that offers daily fantasy sports, online sports betting, and media content tailored to sports enthusiasts.
linked_companies.evidence: DraftKings intertwines its core platform with the sports entertainment sector by monetizing the spectator experience through established ecosystem partnerships, including its official relationship with the NBA. To drive engagement and scale customer acquisition around marquee global events, the company actively aligns its offerings with real-world sports schedules, recently investing in native Spanish-language app functionalities ahead of the World Cup. Additionally, DraftKings maximizes its market reach and distributes targeted content by leveraging strategic relationships with leading national media broadcasters like ESPN and NBCUniversal, directly supporting its Fantasy, Sportsbook, and Predictions verticals.
linked_companies.name: DRAFTKINGS INC-CL A

themes.name: Sports Entertainment

themes.description: Businesses specializing in creating and managing marketing campaigns and media placements for brand promotion across various platforms.

linked_companies.description: Operates a cloud-based programmatic platform that empowers ad buyers to create, manage, and optimize data-driven digital advertising campaigns across diverse channels such as connected TV, audio, and display.
linked_companies.evidence: The Trade Desk functions fundamentally as an independent demand-side platform for programmatic media buying, targeting an expanding $1 trillion global advertising market. The company generates 100% of its revenue by facilitating digital ad campaigns across connected TV, mobile, display, and audio, dedicating over 3,500 employees to support agencies and brands. This engagement is anchored by the company's structural objectivity—choosing not to own media inventory to prevent conflicts of interest—which recently fueled a 55% year-over-year increase in joint business partnerships and secured direct wins over mega-cap competitors.
linked_companies.name: TRADE DESK INC/THE -CLASS A

linked_companies.description: Provides a comprehensive suite of digital advertising solutions across its search engine, video platform, and extensive publisher network, enabling businesses to deliver targeted marketing campaigns to a global audience.
linked_companies.evidence: Alphabet's economic structure relies directly on its digital advertising ecosystem, which generated $77.3 billion—representing over 70% of total revenues—across Google Search, YouTube, and the Google Network in the most recent quarter. To optimize this primary revenue engine, the company is aggressively integrating generative AI throughout its ad network, with over 30% of search ad spend currently utilizing automated tools like Performance Max. Alphabet continuously updates its advertiser offerings by testing new ad formats directly within 'AI Mode' results and implementing dozens of improvements to its smart bidding and shopping strategies. Backed by massive organizational investments in marketing and dedicated sales teams, the company also develops creator partnership hubs and retail-focused shoppable mastheads to maximize advertiser conversions across its platforms.
linked_companies.name: ALPHABET INC-CL A

linked_companies.description: Delivers comprehensive advertising, strategic media planning, and digital marketing services through a global network of agencies to drive brand strategy, public relations, and consumer engagement across diverse markets.
linked_companies.evidence: Omnicom's foundation in the Advertising industry is driven by its $9 billion acquisition of Interpublic Group (IPG), establishing the combined entity as a global market leader. Following this integration, management restructured operations by merging over 20 agency brands into a dedicated Advertising operating discipline, which explicitly accounts for 17% of the firm's core revenue. This global network houses specialized creative subsidiaries like BBDO, TBWA, and McCann, leveraging combined operational scale to win pitches and secure global clients such as IBM, GSK, and John Deere.
linked_companies.name: OMNICOM GROUP

linked_companies.description: Provides out-of-home advertising services through an extensive network of billboards, transit displays, and highway logo signs, enabling brands to execute targeted marketing and promotional campaigns.
linked_companies.evidence: Lamar Advertising Company operates strictly as an out-of-home advertising enterprise, generating its entire revenue from media placements across billboards, airports, transit networks, and logos. To advance this core operational focus, the company's dedicated executive leadership allocated a $186 million capital expenditure budget for 2026, alongside an $80 million cash investment for recent billboard acquisitions. This capital allocation directly expands a monetized portfolio of over 5,600 digital spaces and physical structures, which is primarily driven by local and regional brand promotion campaigns that account for 82% of billboard revenues.
linked_companies.name: LAMAR ADVERTISING CO-A

linked_companies.description: Operates an extensive out-of-home advertising network of billboard and transit displays, delivering marketing solutions that connect brands with audiences in high-traffic environments.
linked_companies.evidence: OUTFRONT Media operates strictly as a pure-play out-of-home advertising business, deriving its entire consolidated revenue from its Billboard and Transit media placements. The company's competitive positioning as a leader in "in real-life" (IRL) media is anchored by exclusive structural assets, such as its New York MTA transit advertising contract, alongside newly appointed executive leadership driving programmatic ad sales. Reinforcing its transition into a modernized marketing powerhouse, OUTFRONT dedicates its entire projected $90 million 2026 capital expenditure budget exclusively toward maintaining and expanding its physical and digital advertising infrastructure. Furthermore, a comprehensive reorganization of its sales force into specialized commercial teams and strategic technology partnerships, including an exclusive arrangement with the AI-powered planning platform AdQuick, directly align its corporate operations with advancing omnichannel advertising capabilities.
linked_companies.name: OUTFRONT MEDIA INC

themes.name: Advertising

themes.description: Platforms offering media content directly to consumers over the internet, enabling on-demand access and convenient delivery of films, series, music, and other entertainment.

linked_companies.description: Operates a global subscription-based entertainment platform that delivers a diverse library of original and licensed films, television series, and games directly to consumers across internet-connected devices.
linked_companies.evidence: Netflix operates as a pure-play streaming platform, generating its revenue almost entirely from subscriptions and advertising across a global user base of 325 million paid members. Directed by its executive leadership team, the company centers its strategic and capital allocation framework on enhancing its media delivery infrastructure, allocating nearly a billion dollars in quarterly technology and development spending. To maximize engagement across an addressable market of 800 million smart TV households, the platform is expanding its core offerings into multi-format entertainment, recently drawing 31.4 million viewers for live programming such as the World Baseball Classic. The company's fundamental reliance on the streaming sector is further evidenced by major strategic maneuvers, including its recent multi-billion dollar pursuit of Warner Bros. Discovery's direct-to-consumer assets to expand its studio and content portfolio.
linked_companies.name: NETFLIX INC

linked_companies.description: Operates a comprehensive television streaming platform that connects users to digital content through proprietary operating systems, streaming players, and smart TVs, while driving monetization through advertising, premium subscriptions, and content distribution.
linked_companies.evidence: Roku functions as a central distribution ecosystem in the Streaming Platforms & Services industry, recently surpassing 100 million streaming households globally and facilitating nearly half of all streaming time in U.S. broadband households. The company monetizes this vast scale through its Platform segment—which generated 91% of total net revenue in recent quarters—by distributing third-party apps and expanding owned-and-operated services such as The Roku Channel, the ad-free subscription service Howdy, and the recently acquired Frndly TV. To maintain this infrastructure, the company utilizes a dedicated Roku Media division led by a President-level executive and directs its engineering headcount and R&D efforts toward enhancing its proprietary Roku TV OS and deploying major home screen updates.
linked_companies.name: ROKU INC

linked_companies.description: Provides a global digital audio streaming platform that delivers music, podcasts, and audiobooks to users through ad-supported and premium subscription models, driving engagement via personalized content discovery.
linked_companies.evidence: Spotify operates as a direct-to-consumer internet media streaming platform, generating its EUR 4.5 billion in recent quarterly revenue entirely from premium subscriptions and ad-supported tiers. The system delivers on-demand digital content, including music, podcasts, audiobooks, and newly added fitness videos, to 761 million monthly active users and 293 million subscribers. The company's organizational structure and capital strategy are dedicated to maintaining and expanding this ecosystem, demonstrated by continuous technological reinvestments and an $11 billion payout to content rights holders.
linked_companies.name: SPOTIFY TECHNOLOGY SA

linked_companies.description: Operates direct-to-consumer streaming platforms that distribute a comprehensive library of original programming, legacy media franchises, and live sports broadcasts to a global subscriber base.
linked_companies.evidence: Disney positions streaming platforms at the core of its operational strategy, explicitly targeting the evolution of Disney+ into the interactive digital centerpiece of the enterprise. Supported by the dedicated Disney Entertainment DTC unit, specialized technology teams are aggressively iterating product enhancements, including a fully integrated Hulu experience designed to reduce subscriber churn. These ecosystem improvements, combined with global content scaling and targeted bundling strategies, have accelerated sequential SVOD revenue growth to 13% and propelled streaming revenues to more than double those of traditional linear networks. Furthermore, following a corporate restructuring to ensure executive bottom-line accountability, these multi-billion dollar capital investments have successfully transitioned the streaming segment into a highly profitable division characterized by double-digit financial margins.
